question: 28yo, abdominal pain, previously healthy, ER (implied acute fatty liver/HELLP-like), LFT finding

options.text: This patient need admission, pain killers and, IV fluids
The most likely diagnosis gallstones and stone in the common bile duct
The cause of clay color stool is absence of stercobilinogen from stool
The cause of tea color urine is increased conjugated bilirubin in urine
The serum liver function test will most likely show decreased alkaline phosphatase

correct_text: The serum liver function test will most likely show decreased alkaline phosphatase
